articles.title: Anthropic Releases Claude 4 with Extended Reasoning and 2M Token Context Window
articles.summary: Anthropic officially launched Claude 4, featuring a breakthrough 2 million token context window and enhanced chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities. The model demonstrates significant improvements on coding and scientific benchmarks, outperforming competitors on several key tasks. Early enterprise customers report dramatic productivity gains in document analysis and multi-step research workflows.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2.5 Achieves State-of-the-Art on AGI Benchmarks
articles.summary: Google DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2.5, which has set new records on the ARC-AGI-2 and FrontierMath evaluation suites. The model exhibits improved spatial reasoning and novel problem-solving capabilities that researchers say represent a qualitative leap in general intelligence metrics. DeepMind emphasized that the model passed all internal safety evaluations before deployment.

articles.title: OpenAI Operator Agents Now Handle End-to-End Enterprise Workflows Autonomously
articles.summary: OpenAI expanded its Operator platform to support fully autonomous multi-agent pipelines that can execute complex enterprise workflows without human intervention. The system integrates with over 400 third-party business tools including Salesforce, SAP, and ServiceNow. Critics and safety researchers are calling for stronger oversight mechanisms as adoption accelerates across Fortune 500 companies.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Scout Open-Source Multimodal Model Under Permissive License
articles.summary: Meta open-sourced Llama 4 Scout, a 72-billion parameter multimodal model capable of processing images, video, and audio alongside text. The model is available on Hugging Face with a fully permissive commercial license, a notable departure from previous Llama release restrictions. Developers have already begun fine-tuning experiments and the model topped the open-source leaderboard within 48 hours of release.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Body Issues First Major Fines to Three Tech Companies
articles.summary: The newly established European AI Office issued its first significant penalties under the AI Act, fining three major technology firms a combined €840 million for deploying high-risk AI systems without proper conformity assessments. The companies, whose names are under legal dispute, are believed to include a large social media platform and two hiring algorithm providers. Legal experts say the fines signal that EU regulators are prepared to aggressively enforce the landmark legislation.

articles.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio Gains Real-Time RAG Pipelines Powered by Azure AI Search
articles.summary: Microsoft unveiled a major upgrade to Copilot Studio that enables developers to build real-time retrieval-augmented generation pipelines with sub-second latency using the revamped Azure AI Search service. The update includes automatic document chunking strategies, hybrid vector-keyword search, and built-in hallucination detection guardrails. The feature is now generally available across all Azure regions.

articles.title: Stanford HAI Report Finds AI Coding Assistants Introduce Security Vulnerabilities at Scale
articles.summary: A comprehensive study from Stanford's Human-Centered AI Institute analyzed over 2.3 million code commits assisted by AI tools and found that 14% contained at least one exploitable security vulnerability. The research highlights that developers often accept AI-generated code with minimal review, compounding risk in production environments. The authors recommend mandatory AI code scanning requirements and updated developer training programs.

articles.title: Runway Gen-4 Video Model Generates Photorealistic 4K Clips from Text with Consistent Characters
articles.summary: Runway released Gen-4, its most advanced video generation model to date, capable of producing 60-second 4K video clips with consistent character identity across scenes. The model addresses a long-standing limitation of previous generative video systems by maintaining coherent facial features and clothing through complex camera movements. Hollywood studios and independent filmmakers have flooded social media with early test outputs, sparking renewed debate about AI's impact on the creative industry.
